WITH source_year_stats AS (
    SELECT
        apm.measurement_source_id,
        ms.source_year,
        COUNT(*) AS measurement_count,
        AVG(apm.measurement_value) AS avg_measurement_value
    FROM allele_peptide_measurements AS apm
    JOIN measurement_sources AS ms
        ON apm.measurement_source_id = ms.source_id
    JOIN alleles AS a
        ON apm.allele_id = a.allele_id
    WHERE apm.measurement_value IS NOT NULL
      AND ms.source_year IS NOT NULL
      AND a.class IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY apm.measurement_source_id, ms.source_year
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
ranked_years AS (
    SELECT
        measurement_source_id,
        source_year,
        measurement_count,
        avg_measurement_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY measurement_source_id
            ORDER BY measurement_count DESC, source_year DESC
        ) AS year_rank
    FROM source_year_stats
),
surviving_years AS (
    SELECT
        measurement_source_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year_rank = 1 THEN source_year END) AS latest_selected_year,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year_rank = 2 THEN source_year END) AS previous_selected_year,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year_rank = 1 THEN avg_measurement_value END) AS latest_avg_measurement_value,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year_rank = 2 THEN avg_measurement_value END) AS previous_avg_measurement_value
    FROM ranked_years
    WHERE year_rank <= 2
    GROUP BY measurement_source_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(latest_avg_measurement_value - previous_avg_measurement_value), 2) AS average_change_between_periods
FROM surviving_years

WITH article_access_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.article_id,
        a.title AS article_title,
        j.journal_id,
        j.title AS journal_title,
        MIN(al.access_date) AS first_access_date,
        MAX(al.access_date) AS last_access_date,
        CAST(julianday(MAX(al.access_date)) - julianday(MIN(al.access_date)) AS INTEGER) AS access_span_days,
        COUNT(al.access_id) AS total_access_events,
        COUNT(DISTINCT al.user_id) AS distinct_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT al.ip_address) AS distinct_ip_addresses,
        AVG(CASE WHEN al.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS known_user_ratio,
        AVG(CASE WHEN al.access_type IS NOT NULL THEN LENGTH(al.access_type) END) AS avg_access_type_length,
        MAX(LENGTH(COALESCE(al.ip_address, ''))) AS max_ip_address_length,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(al.access_id) >= 100 THEN 'high_activity'
            WHEN COUNT(al.access_id) >= 25 THEN 'medium_activity'
            ELSE 'low_activity'
        END AS activity_label
    FROM articles AS a
    JOIN journals AS j
        ON a.journal_id = j.journal_id
    JOIN access_logs AS al
        ON al.article_id = a.article_id
    WHERE al.access_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        a.article_id,
        a.title,
        j.journal_id,
        j.title
)
SELECT
    article_id,
    article_title,
    journal_id,
    journal_title,
    first_access_date,
    last_access_date,
    access_span_days,
    total_access_events,
    distinct_users,
    distinct_ip_addresses,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * total_access_events / NULLIF(access_span_days + 1, 0),
        2
    ) AS accesses_per_day,
    ROUND(known_user_ratio, 3) AS known_user_ratio,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * distinct_ip_addresses / NULLIF(total_access_events, 0),
        3
    ) AS ip_diversity_ratio,
    ROUND(avg_access_type_length, 2) AS avg_access_type_length,
    max_ip_address_length,
    activity_label
FROM article_access_stats
ORDER BY access_span_days DESC, total_access_events DESC

WITH crop_sim_stats AS (
    SELECT
        c.crop_id,
        c.crop_name,
        s.simulation_id,
        s.simulation_name,
        s.status,
        s.start_date,
        s.end_date,
        COUNT(r.result_id) AS result_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.soil_id) AS distinct_soil_count,
        AVG(r.precipitation_yearTotal) AS avg_precipitation_year_total,
        AVG(r.p_soil_meanARID) AS avg_soil_mean_arid,
        MAX(r.p_water) AS max_water_content,
        MIN(r.p_ecol_albedo) AS min_albedo,
        CASE
            WHEN julianday(s.end_date) IS NOT NULL
                 AND julianday(s.start_date) IS NOT NULL
                 AND julianday(s.end_date) > julianday(s.start_date)
            THEN COUNT(r.result_id) * 1.0 / (julianday(s.end_date) - julianday(s.start_date))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS results_per_day,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(r.result_id) > 0
            THEN COUNT(DISTINCT r.soil_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(r.result_id)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS soils_per_result_ratio,
        CASE
            WHEN AVG(r.precipitation_yearTotal) >= 200 THEN 'wet'
            WHEN AVG(r.precipitation_yearTotal) >= 100 THEN 'moderate'
            WHEN AVG(r.precipitation_yearTotal) IS NOT NULL THEN 'dry'
            ELSE 'no_data'
        END AS precipitation_band
    FROM crops AS c
    JOIN results AS r
        ON r.crop_id = c.crop_id
    JOIN simulations AS s
        ON s.simulation_id = r.simulation_id
    GROUP BY
        c.crop_id,
        c.crop_name,
        s.simulation_id,
        s.simulation_name,
        s.status,
        s.start_date,
        s.end_date
)
SELECT
    crop_id,
    crop_name,
    simulation_id,
    simulation_name,
    results_per_day,
    result_count,
    distinct_soil_count,
    soils_per_result_ratio,
    avg_precipitation_year_total,
    avg_soil_mean_arid,
    max_water_content,
    min_albedo,
    precipitation_band,
    status AS simulation_status
FROM crop_sim_stats
WHERE result_count > 0

measure: a per-unit rate (per day, per member, per km)
gold_sql:
WITH experiments_per_gene AS (
    SELECT
        gene_id,
        COUNT(*) AS experiment_count
    FROM gene_experiments
    WHERE gene_id IS NOT NULL
      AND experiment_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY gene_id
),
history_span_per_gene AS (
    SELECT
        gene_id,
        COUNT(*) AS history_event_count,
        MIN(change_date) AS first_change_date,
        MAX(change_date) AS last_change_date,
        CASE
            WHEN julianday(MAX(change_date)) - julianday(MIN(change_date)) = 0 THEN 1.0
            ELSE julianday(MAX(change_date)) - julianday(MIN(change_date))
        END AS history_span_days
    FROM gene_history
    WHERE gene_id IS NOT NULL
      AND change_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY gene_id
),
gene_level_rates AS (
    SELECT
        gs.gene_id,
        gs.order_num,
        gs.score,
        epg.experiment_count,
        hpg.history_event_count,
        hpg.history_span_days,
        CAST(epg.experiment_count AS REAL) / hpg.history_span_days AS experiments_per_day
    FROM gene_scores AS gs
    JOIN experiments_per_gene AS epg
        ON gs.gene_id = epg.gene_id
    JOIN history_span_per_gene AS hpg
        ON gs.gene_id = hpg.gene_id
    WHERE gs.gene_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    gene_id AS gene_id,
    order_num AS order_num,
    score AS score,
    experiment_count AS experiment_count,
    history_event_count AS history_event_count,
    ROUND(history_span_days, 2) AS history_span_days,
    ROUND(experiments_per_day, 4) AS experiments_per_day
FROM gene_level_rates
ORDER BY experiments_per_day DESC, gene_id
LIMIT 10

WITH valid_collection_days AS (
    SELECT
        c.biosample_id,
        c.collection_date
    FROM collections AS c
    WHERE c.biosample_id IS NOT NULL
      AND c.collection_date IS NOT NULL
      AND c.collection_date <> 'Unknown'
      AND date(c.collection_date) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.biosample_id, c.collection_date
),
biosample_collection_stats AS (
    SELECT
        b.biosample_id,
        b.organism_name AS biosample_organism_name,
        o.common_name AS organism_common_name,
        COUNT(c.collection_id) AS total_collection_events,
        COUNT(vcd.collection_date) AS events_on_valid_dated_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT vcd.collection_date) AS valid_collection_day_count,
        ROUND(
            1.0 * COUNT(c.collection_id) /
            NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT vcd.collection_date), 0),
            3
        ) AS collection_events_per_valid_collection_day
    FROM biosamples AS b
    LEFT JOIN organisms AS o
        ON b.taxonomy_id = o.taxonomy_id
    LEFT JOIN collections AS c
        ON b.biosample_id = c.biosample_id
    LEFT JOIN valid_collection_days AS vcd
        ON c.biosample_id = vcd.biosample_id
       AND c.collection_date = vcd.collection_date
    GROUP BY
        b.biosample_id,
        b.organism_name,
        o.common_name
)
SELECT
    biosample_id,
    biosample_organism_name,
    organism_common_name,
    total_collection_events,
    events_on_valid_dated_days,
    valid_collection_day_count,
    collection_events_per_valid_collection_day
FROM biosample_collection_stats
WHERE total_collection_events > 0
ORDER BY collection_events_per_valid_collection_day DESC, biosample_id
